name: std::has_facet

declarations.code:
template <class Facet>

bool has_facet(const locale &loc) throw();

template <class Facet>

bool has_facet(const locale &loc) noexcept;

intro:
Checks if the locale loc implements the facet Facet.

The program is ill-formed if Facet is not a facet or it is a volatile-qualified facet.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
loc

 -

 the locale object to query

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Returns true if the facet Facet was installed in the locale loc, false otherwise.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: std::has_facet must return true for all locales loc if Facet is one of the standard facets given here.

examples.output:
Can loc classify chars? true
Can loc classify char32_t? false
Does loc implement myfacet? true

summary: Checks if the locale loc implements the facet Facet.
